Phone tips

Stuck?

01Company Wi-Fi blocks the portal?

Switch to your own 4G/5G and try again.

02Condition text cut off?

Texts longer than 2 lines have a "Show full condition ▾" link.

0324 hours passed without paying?

The slot goes back to stock. Contact the PM if you have a reason.

04Cannot find a button?

Tap ☰ at the top right.
